intervals.note: Dates are the operating period of the detectors, a bound on the collaboration's life, not a formation date (none was found).
intervals.quote: The HiRes1 site has been in operation since May 1997 and has been collecting monocular data.

intervals.label: completed (analysis continued)
intervals.note: Start is the end of data taking; HiRes results were still being published afterwards (final results 2010).
intervals.quote: operated on clear, moonless nights over a period of nine years (1997-2006)

summary.plain: The group of physicists from the United States, Japan and elsewhere that built and ran the HiRes fluorescence detectors in Utah.
summary.technical: Collaboration of institutions including the University of Utah, Los Alamos National Laboratory, Columbia University, Rutgers University, Montana State University, the University of Tokyo ICRR and the University of New Mexico (affiliation list of the 2007 GZK paper).
